svg.text: Your parts: ESP32 DevKit V1 30-pin (USB-C at the bottom) · 2.8" ILI9341 TFT · KY-040 encoder · 7 buttons · buzzer + 2N2222 + 1 kΩ · WS2812B-8 stick + 330 Ω
Buttons: internal pull-ups, no resistors · always pressed? turn it 90°
MISO / touch / SD pins: not used
jumper J1 on the back: leave OPEN
solder a header to the GND / VCC / IN pads first
USB serial to the game (keep free)
5V tag = ESP32 VIN pin (USB power) → TFT VCC, buzzer +, LED stick VCC
3V3 tag = ESP32 3V3 pin → encoder +, TFT LED (never 5V on the encoder)
Ground symbol = any GND pin; all grounds are joined
Tags with → are the same wire drawn in two places (e.g. ESP32 D4 ↔ encoder SW)
Breadboard positions for every wire: docs/images/breadboard-layout.png and the wire table in docs/03-hardware.md.
